facts.business: Ace Edutrend Limited is an education sector company focused on skill development, vocational education, technology-enabled learning solutions, training and capacity-building programs, collaborative educational projects, and professional employability-oriented courses.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion; company has not maintained proper records of Property Plant and Equipment, fixed assets not physically verified, no fixed assets register maintained, provisions of section 185 and 186 of Companies Act 2013 not complied with, no board resolutions or loan/investment registers made available

key_risks: Regulatory Risk - Changes in government policies, educational regulations, accreditation requirements, and compliance frameworks
Competitive Risk - Highly competitive sector with established institutions, private training providers, ed-tech companies, and new market entrants
Technology Risk - Rapid technological changes requiring continuous adaptation to digital learning methods and evolving learner expectations
Market Risk - Economic conditions, changing student preferences, and demand fluctuations in educational and vocational programs
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances: Aggregate amount of loans/advances in nature of loans repayable on demand is Rs 5,77,35,945 (100% of total loans). Company received Rs 900,000 during the year. Loans are interest-free from previous years. No loans given during the year.
